SELECT ps.id AS performanceSeatId, ps.performance_id AS performanceId, ps.seat_id AS seatId,
s.section_name AS sectionName, s.floor AS floor, s.row_name AS rowName, s.seat_number AS seatNumber, s.seat_type AS seatType,
ps.grade AS grade, ps.price AS price, ps.status AS status,
ps.held_by AS heldBy, ps.held_until AS heldUntil
FROM v1_performance_seats ps
INNER JOIN v1_seats s ON s.id = ps.seat_id
ORDER BY s.floor ASC, s.section_name ASC, s.row_name ASC, s.seat_number ASC, ps.id ASC
LIMIT #{condition.size} OFFSET #{condition.offset}

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM v1_performance_seats ps
INNER JOIN v1_seats s ON s.id = ps.seat_id
